title: Gradient Descent Optimization with Visual QA

scenes.narration_text: Gradient descent is a first-order optimization algorithm used to find local minima of a loss function.
scenes.visual_description: Loss function curve and initial parameter display

scenes.narration_text: At each step, parameters are updated in the opposite direction of the gradient to descend the loss curve.
scenes.visual_description: Point moving down the parabola curve towards the minimum

scenes.narration_text: When the gradient approaches zero, the step sizes shrink and the algorithm converges to the optimal parameter.
scenes.visual_description: Point stabilizes at the global minimum with confirmation box
